# Mai-Lun Chiu, Ph.D. (邱美倫 教授)

> Professor, Natural and Applied Sciences, General Education Center; Dean, Library and Information Services Office (圖資長); and Executive Director, Campus AI Initiative (校園AI推動執行長, since Sep 2026), National Kaohsiung University of Hospitality and Tourism (NKUHT, 國立高雄餐旅大學), Taiwan. Research on knowledge-driven innovation: generative AI in higher education, open innovation, absorptive capacity, knowledge management, supply-chain collaboration, online impulse buying, loyalty programs and smart hospitality.

- Name variants: Mai-Lun Chiu; Chiu, Mai-Lun; Chiu, Mai Lun; 邱美倫; Mellen Chiu
- Email (full-text requests): mlchiu@staff.nkuht.edu.tw
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=4PcZqNAAAAAJ
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0001-6545-575X

- ResearchGate: https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Mai-Lun-Chiu

- Google Scholar: 1,690 citations, h-index 9
- Most-cited paper: International Journal of Information Management (2020), 450+ citations (OpenAlex)
- PI of 11 NSTC grants; 36+ funded projects; NSTC Research Award 2024 and 2026

## Selected journal articles (summaries only; full text on request by email)
- Chiu & Lin (2026). Aligning tourists' needs with loyalty programs: A framework for enhancing brand loyalty. Journal of Destination Marketing & Management. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jdmm.2026.101129 — Survey of 571 participants: loyalty programs combining intrinsic rewards and financial incentives build stronger loyalty; social media engagement enhances effectiveness; product involvement moderates.
- Chiu (2025). Exploring user awareness and perceived usefulness of generative AI in higher education: The moderating role of trust. Education and Information Technologies (SSCI Q1, sole author). https://doi.org/10.1007/s10639-025-13612-7 — Status-quo bias + technology affordance model; affordances raise awareness, resistance lowers it; trust negatively moderates accountability (compensatory mechanism).
- Chiu, Cheng & Lin (2024). Driving open innovation capability through new knowledge diffusion... Journal of the Knowledge Economy (SSCI Q1). https://doi.org/10.1007/s13132-023-01315-8 — TOE + motivation theory; individual absorptive capacity moderates diffusion → innovation capability.
- Chiu, Chiao & Lin (2024). The mediating role of absorptive capability ... social media on open inbound innovation. Information Systems Frontiers (SCI Q1). https://doi.org/10.1007/s10796-023-10381-x — Multi-level study; social-media internalization → socialization → absorptive capability → inbound open innovation.
- Chiu & Lin (2022). Developing supply chain open innovation capability... Journal of Innovation & Knowledge (SSCI Q1, IF 15.6). https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jik.2022.100264 — IoT/cloud technology drives open innovation capability more than formal or relational governance, via knowledge creation.
- Cheng, Chen, Chiu & Su (2022). Artificial intelligence in weaning clinical practice. Indonesian Journal of Business Analytics. https://doi.org/10.55927/ijba.v2i2.1252 — C4.5 decision tree on 1,014 ventilator-weaning cases; 17 clinical rules.
- Hung, Talley, Kuo & Chiu (2021). Exploring cloud-based bookstore continuance from a deconstructed task–technology fit perspective. JTAER (SSCI Q1). https://doi.org/10.3390/jtaer16030023
- Wu, Chiu & Chen (2020). Defining the determinants of online impulse buying... International Journal of Information Management (SSCI Q1). https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijinfomgt.2020.102099 — Perceived risk + expectation-confirmation + flow theory.
- Li, Hung, Hsian, Heung, Chiu & Wang (2019). Teaching ecosystem design: Teachers' satisfaction with the Integrated Course Service System in Taiwan. Education Sciences. https://doi.org/10.3390/educsci9030232
- Wu & Chiu (2018). Examining supply chain collaboration with determinants and performance impact: Social capital, justice, and technology use perspectives. IJIM (SSCI Q1). https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijinfomgt.2017.11.004
- Wu, Chen & Chiu (2016). Defining key drivers of online impulse purchasing: A perspective of both impulse shoppers and system users. IJIM (SSCI Q1). https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ijinfomgt.2015.11.015
- Wu & Chiu (2015). Organizational applications of IT innovation and firm's competitive performance. Journal of Engineering and Technology Management (SSCI). https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jengtecman.2014.09.002
